title: Clinical ORM entities
goal: Show persistent clinical entities and their appointment relationships.

rubric.must: Patient, Practitioner, Appointment, and Clinic have generalization arrows pointing to abstract BaseEntity.
Appointment has a filled composition diamond to AppointmentNote.
Appointment has directed associations to both Patient and Practitioner with visible multiplicities.
AppointmentRepository is visibly an interface with a dashed dependency to Appointment.
AppointmentStatus visibly lists scheduled, cancelled, and completed states.
